Wrap every direct h.app.addPage/switchPage/renamePage/reorderPages/deletePage and h.setState call in `act(() => { ... })` (act is re-exported from ./test-utils; see appStateHooks.test.tsx), capturing return values (e.g. `let page2!: string; act(() => { page2 = h.app.addPage(); });`). Keep every assertion. (3) yarn test:code prettier at 195:12 and 196:12: wrap `{ ...API.createElement({ type: "rectangle", id: "a1" }), pageId: "a" }` one property per line with trailing comma (same for b1/"b").
